name: word-roller-drum
title: Word Roller Drum
description: A word cycles on the face of a rotating 3D drum beside a fixed prefix: each spring turn brings the next word round, and the last one stays.
useWhen: A fixed lead-in word followed by a changing word, with a physical, mechanical feel.
A short list of four or five words that should land on one chosen word.
avoidWhen: The words are long or there are more than about six: the drum faces turn edge-on and read poorly.
You want a flat vertical roll: use inline-word-roll.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the drum words in pixels. A wide line shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Word color
variables.description: Color of the words on the drum.

variables.label: Frames per word
variables.description: Length of one drum turn in 30 fps frames.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
